subject: Post-call: procurement readiness & packaging fit
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement readiness & packaging fit

Hi Emma — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and clear next steps so procurement has what they need. I’ve looped in Ben (pricing) and Priyom (solutions) for visibility.

Recap from today’s call:
- Goal: pilot LLM-powered extraction for customer support routing across PII and non-PII flows.
- Preferred starting deployment: Hosted API to iterate quickly; dedicated or private considered if/when PII scope increases.
- Key procurement asks you mentioned: vendor form, SOC 2 evidence, insurance certificate, PoC ordering path (PO vs card), and whether marketplace billing is possible.

Options we recommend before procurement starts:
1) Hosted (fastest): self-serve with card or PO via invoice. Good for short pilots; supports commits or on-demand billing.
2) Dedicated (predictable): reserved capacity, monthly commit; recommended if sustained throughput and stricter isolation required.
3) Private (VPC/on‑prem): for regulated PII workloads — longer lead time, enterprise contract and deployment.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm procurement’s preferred billing flow: PO + invoice or company card?
- Are you interested in completing the vendor form or would you prefer to transact via marketplace (faster payment for some buyers)?
- Who is the procurement POC (name + email) and target procurement review date?

Attached: redwood-pricing-one-pager.pdf and a short SOW template. I’ll follow up with a pricing note that shows committed vs on-demand cost for a typical pilot.

If it helps, we can schedule a short call with your procurement/legal next week to walk through the vendor form and standard terms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: redwood-pricing-one-pager.pdf, redwood-sow-draft.docx

From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@olive-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olive Analytics Legal <legal@olive-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & packaging fit

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement preference: PO + invoice is our standard for vendor relationships; card can be used for one-off purchases but procurement will push for PO for pilots over $5k.
- Marketplace: we are open to marketplace billing if Redwood is listed and the terms match our net-30 process — it speeds things up for SOWs under $25k.
- Compliance: we’ll need SOC 2 Type II, data processing addendum (DPA), and an insurance cert. For any PII processing we will likely request dedicated or private; for the pilot we prefer hosted non-PII data.
- Timeline: procurement kickoff this Friday (2027-05-07). Legal will review vendor form — attaching the vendor form they asked us to start with (olive-vendor-form.pdf).

POC: Daniel Kim (procurement) — daniel.kim@olive-analytics.com. He’ll coordinate the vendor questionnaire and insurance.

Happy to meet with your team next week to walk through the vendor form.

—Emma
Emma Jensen
Head of Platform Engineering | Olive Analytics
emma.jensen@olive-analytics.com

Attachment: olive-vendor-form.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@olive-analytics.com>, Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & packaging fit

Thanks Daniel / Emma — looping you in, Daniel, since Emma mentioned you’ll own the vendor form. Quick note on packaging/pricing to help procurement evaluate options: 

1) Pilot (recommended start): Hosted, non-PII only. Billing via PO/invoice. We can support either on-demand (pay-as-you-go) or a short monthly commit to get a lower per-token price during the pilot. Typical pilot commit we’ve seen is 25k–100k tokens/month depending on volume — I’ll include two example pricing rows (in the attached pricing appendix).

2) Mid-term (if pilot succeeds): Dedicated capacity with monthly reserved GPUs. This is where committed discounts become meaningful (we can offer stepped discounts at 3m and 12m commit horizons). Contract requires a MSA and exhibit for dedicated deployment.

3) Regulated/PII: Private deployment (VPC or on-prem). Longer procurement and deployment window — usually 8–12 weeks from signed agreement.

We’ll provide the following to expedite review: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA template, insurance certificate, standard MSA, and a short pricing appendix showing commit vs on-demand. I’ve attached the pricing appendix to this message.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Daniel: review attached vendor form and let us know which fields need evidence (e.g., hosted environment, subcontractor list).
- Procurement meeting: Wed 2027-05-05 or Thu 2027-05-06 — which works for you? We can keep it to 30 minutes to walk the vendor form and payment path.
- Emma: confirm pilot target (volume bucket or expected usage). That will let Ben size a recommended commit (if any).

Thanks — we’ll keep the SOW flexible for either PO invoicing or marketplace purchase depending on Olive’s preference.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood-pricing-one-pager.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & packaging fit

Adding a quick pricing note here — hi Daniel, Ben from Redwood. A couple of practical contract items to keep in mind as you evaluate: 

- Commit economics: for pilots, a 3-month commit gives a ~12–18% token discount versus on-demand; 12-month commitments increase that to ~25% depending on capacity mix. If you want a sample quote I can produce two SKUs: Pilot Commit (3m) and On-Demand.
- Minimums: we don’t require a large upfront for hosted pilots; a small initial invoice tied to a pilot commit is common.
- Marketplace: we are in the marketplace for a subset of packaged SKUs — if you prefer marketplace we can route the initial pilot there, but some enterprise paperwork (MSA) will still be necessary for post-pilot dedicated/private options.
- SalesOps: Priyom — please prepare a commissionable quote and include DocuSign links.

Daniel — if you can share expected monthly token volume (or rough user counts), I’ll model numbers and include both PO/invoice and marketplace price rows.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@olive-analytics.com>

Estimated pilot volume: likely in the 50k–75k tokens/month range initially. We prefer PO + net-30 invoice. Marketplace is acceptable if the SKU matches our procurement fields. Please send the pricing rows for 50k and 75k token buckets (on-demand + 3m commit).

I’ll forward any additional insurance/contract fields from legal after their review.

Regards,
Daniel Kim
